purpose: Determine which independence and generalization claims are supported by the released CooperScene take timestamps before using the traces to certify communication conclusions.

sourceArtifacts.role: Provides independently parsed MCAP Statistics message start and end timestamps for all 14 official takes.
Canonical CooperScene release page and take inventory.
Canonical release code used to interpret the trace topics and benchmark packaging.

timestampMethod.arithmetic: Exact integer subtraction with BigInt, converted to seconds only after subtraction.
timestampMethod.scope: The timestamps establish recording order, duration, and temporal spacing. They do not by themselves establish statistical independence, environmental diversity, or repeated-deployment status.

campaignSummary.interpretation: All release takes occupy one short, contiguous collection window. The release is a finite set of temporally related recordings, not evidence of 14 independent deployment sessions.

supportedClaims: A deterministic statement about all 14 released takes, with every take reported separately and no population interpretation.
A finite-release worst-case, best-case, or all-take aggregate whose estimand is explicitly restricted to this exact release.
Leave-one-take-out sensitivity analysis described as release-set robustness, not as an estimate of deployment generalization.
Matched comparisons that preserve take, directed link, workload definition, and common observation horizon.
unsupportedClaims: Treating frames, links, or takes as independent and identically distributed deployment samples.
Reporting confidence intervals or significance tests that rely on naive frame-level or link-level independence.
Generalizing a success probability from the 14 takes to unseen intersections, radios, weather, traffic, hardware, or deployments.
Calling the 14 takes independent sessions solely because they are separate files.
Using random frame splits that allow adjacent observations from the same collection window to appear in both train and test sets.

requiredEvaluationContract.primaryEstimand: Finite-release verdict stability across all 14 official takes.
requiredEvaluationContract.reportingUnit: Take-by-directed-link cells, retaining the original take identifier.
requiredEvaluationContract.aggregation: Publish every take result, the finite-release minimum and maximum, and an explicitly named all-release aggregate.
requiredEvaluationContract.censoring: Use a common restriction horizon and retain incomplete transfers as right-censored outcomes; do not compute completion quantiles from completed transfers alone.
requiredEvaluationContract.splitPolicy: No random frame split. Any model fitting or calibration must separate entire takes and report temporal order.
requiredEvaluationContract.equivalencePolicy: Freeze the practical equivalence margin before viewing comparative results. Degenerate all-success or all-failure cells cannot establish a meaningful equivalence claim.
requiredEvaluationContract.generalizationLabel: No external-deployment or population-generalization claim without a second independently collected campaign.

remainingDependenceGap.reason: The summary audit decoded topic schemas and per-channel message counts for all takes, but throughput payload values have been decoded only for take 9.
neededEvidence: Decode the 12 directed throughput payload series for all 14 takes.
Check repeated or near-duplicate throughput subsequences within and across takes.
Measure within-take and cross-take autocorrelation with take boundaries preserved.
Compare link-direction distributions and identify whether apparent replication is dominated by the same radio pair.
Keep these diagnostics descriptive because a single collection campaign still cannot establish population independence.

decision.candidateDesignConsequence: The cooperative-driving idea must certify whether a communication conclusion is identified on this finite release under declared workload and trace interpretations. It must not market the release as a multi-session deployment benchmark.

reproducibility.command: node -e 'read the all-takes summary audit, subtract timestamp strings with BigInt, and emit take durations and inter-take gaps'
manualChecks: Campaign span equals take 14 end minus take 1 start.
Every inter-take gap equals the next take start minus the previous take end.
Total recorded time equals the sum of the 14 Statistics durations.
